documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited submitted its investor presentation for FY 2026-27 outlining its operational performance, robust order book, manufacturing capabilities, and strategic business diversification roadmap. Management highlighted a significant jump in Q1 FY 26-27 financial metrics, including a standalone revenue of ₹502.03 Cr and a total order book of ₹3,487 Cr remaining to be executed. The company is actively scaling its capacity, banking lines, and technical resources in anticipation of a multi-year railway safety rollout driven by Indian Railways' Kavach mandate. Additionally, Kernex detailed expansion plans into five new business domains such as Yard Management Systems, Intelligent Traffic Management, and AI-BIM Digital Twins. Kernex Microsystems reported strong financial growth for Q3 FY25 and 9M FY25, driven by higher revenue and improved gross contributions and EBITDA margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the national rolling stock asset base is continuously growing as Indian Railways adds approximately five new locomotives daily.
demand_outlook.quote: Expanding Fleet Baseline: Indian Railways adds ~approx 5 new locomotives daily (~1,900+ per annum), continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted mandatory regulatory tailwinds requiring 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock to be eventually outfitted with ATP/Kavach modules prior to commissioning.
demand_outlook.quote: Mandatory Regulatory Tailwinds: Per Mandate 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with (ATP/ KAVACH) modules prior to commissioning.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that recruitment of technical and project personnel is underway and resources are being mobilised ahead of anticipated awards.
